Right in the heart of the East Village

Step into Gnocco and be transported to a cozy osteria in Modena, Italy. This hidden gem has been serving authentic Northern Italian cuisine for 25 years, made with fresh, seasonal ingredients and authentic family recipes from Italy.


Gnocco Fritto

Home of the

Our menu celebrates Emilia-Romagna and the Giovanetti family’s roots in Modena, Italy. Enjoy rustic dishes like handmade tagliatelle al ragù, tortelli di zucca, and our signature gnocco fritto—pillowy fried dough with cured meats and cheeses.Wood-fired pizzas and seasonal specials complete the menu.

  • "It’s not just fresh ravioli wrapped up like perfect saltwater taffies, the tortellini served in a slow-simmered chicken and beef broth, or the spinach, ricotta, mascarpone and lemon zest cappellacci, it’s the thin crust Roman-style pizza prepared fresh to order in the brick oven."

    Eva Noelle, Newsbreak
